description: This file contains JavaScript functions that interface with an API to fetch project cost data and cost history summaries. It defines two exported asynchronous functions: getProjectCost and getProjectCostHistorySum, which perform HTTP GET requests to specific API endpoints related to project financial data.

methods.name: getProjectCost(projectId)
methods.description: Fetches the aggregated cost data for a specified project by calling the backend API endpoint /api/projects/:projectId/cost and returns an object with projectId, cost, and currency.

methods.name: getProjectCostHistorySum(projectId)
methods.description: Fetches the total cost for a project based on cost history deltas by calling the backend API endpoint /api/projects/:projectId/cost-history-sum and returns an object with projectId and cost.
